behavior: On failed media admission/signed supervision reads, record current phase elapsed and Node event-loop active/idle milliseconds. Admission additionally records total elapsed across coherent snapshot/native describe. Only known phases and integer0..60000 values survive the closed diagnostic projection; exception messages, arbitrary context, credentials and resource IDs remain excluded. No new timer, polling, retry, cache or deadline change.
measurement_scope: Node main process only. Event-loop active time is not proof of Rust helper or server CPU use; idle time does not identify the remote cause. Runtime measurements and diagnosis remain pending.
reason: Linux31ec signed supervisor hits2s while combined audio is late; Mac prior admission can spend its shared2s before native negotiation. Instrument phase/time without widening bounds.
